Chapter 1444 - 16: Legend (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1444 - 16: Legend (End of This Volume)

Each dimensional space and dimension heaven and earth operate under the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Numerous timelines also extend within the allowable range of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Even the birth of a time being and the tests of the time cyclic world depend on the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Thus, many powerful legendary lords 'jokingly' claim—

If not for the fact that the Supreme Rule Dao lacks specific consciousness and merely maintains the endless dimension operations instinctively.

Then it would be the only Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being.

"Indeed, legendary lords seem powerful and mysterious, but in reality, they are quite pitiable..."

A Legendary Lord bathed in purple light gave a self-deprecating smile. At the level of legendary lords, there is essentially no more progress to be made, forcing them to choose from three transcendence paths whose probabilities approach zero.

Even strong lords like Lord Wanwei eventually perished.

Throughout the ancient days of old, more than just one legendary lord like Lord Wanwei has fallen.

Many legendary lords fell silently, not even having the chance to establish something like the Myriad Realms Gate before passing completely like Lord Wanwei.

Lin Yuan nodded.

The stronger you become, the more insignificant you feel.

"Boundless tribulations..."

Lin Yuan's consciousness perceived the Supreme Rule Dao and likewise felt the 'boundless tribulations' formed under its operation.

All it takes is to connect one's mind with the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, and you can open the path of transcendence called 'boundless tribulations,' where the Supreme Rule Dao will personally bestow tribulations.

Lin Yuan must simply complete the trials to receive empowerment from the Supreme Rule Dao, slightly enhancing his own powers.

"No wonder many lords consider 'boundless tribulations' as a transcendence path, as it surely isn't just directly sourced from the consciousness of the Supreme Rule Dao."

Silently, Lin Yuan contemplated in his heart.

After becoming a Legendary Lord, his mind and will directly connected with the Supreme Rule Dao's consciousness, and Lin Yuan clearly sensed each tribulation passed increased the lord's own strength.

Although each tribulation doesn't increase by much, over three phases with billions of tribulations, it equates to billions of enhancements, and should he truly manage to pass, transcendence is inevitable.

Especially the last phase of three hundred and thirty million tribulations, corresponding to the level of a legendary lord, where each passed brings considerable improvement, enhancing both body and soul and even granting divine skill talents directly bestowed by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

"After becoming a Legendary Lord, I can vaguely perceive the approximate locations where I will arrive in the Origin Worlds."

Lin Yuan appeared contemplative, his gaze distant as he looked in several directions.

Over sixty thousand years of cultivation, aside from the initial four Origin Worlds he descended upon, Lin Yuan subsequently arrived at the fifth Origin World and the sixth Origin World.

The fifth Origin World was an extremely typical cultivation world, but the sixth Origin World... was extraordinarily unique.

The sixth Origin World was not large, not even comparable to the Chaos Void, measuring roughly the size of a naturally-formed universe within the Chaos Void.

Moreover, the lifeforms within the universe were not powerful; the most powerful reached only the Sixth Rank.

However, the rules of this Origin World were terrifyingly formidable, being a special Origin Dao after the complete integration of the Phantasm and Reality, two great Origin Daos.

In this world, the living beings could engage their minds into a Virtual World from the moment of birth.

For lifeforms within the Origin World, the Virtual World seemed fictitious.

But in reality, it was authentic, representing the vast dimensional interstices outside this Origin World.

When life within the Origin World enters the Virtual World, they effectively replace formidable lifeforms in the dimensional interstices, utilizing their bodies to cultivate, hunt, and challenge the so-called 'bosses,' namely the time beings.

During the peak of the sixth Origin World, it commanded the battle strength of tens of thousands of time beings and over a dozen Time Lords, nearly dominating the vastness of the dimensional interstices.

If Lin Yuan hadn't descended upon that Origin World through the Myriad Realms Gate, he couldn't have imagined a dimension so powerful yet essentially so fragile?

The terrifying means of those time beings and Time Lords outside, surprisingly, are controlled by a group of weak beings who haven't even reached the Sixth Rank.

Due to the integration of the Phantasm and Reality, this Origin World sits between reality and fantasy; even for legendary lords, locking onto its exact coordinates is impossible.

Descending to such an Origin World greatly benefited Lin Yuan in comprehending Phantasm Reality, alongside awakening the mystical Physical Body Divine Ability.

...

[Name: Lin Yuan]

[Identity: Holder of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Bonded Talent: Heaven-defying Comprehension]

[Divine Power: Blood Resurrection]

[Divine Power: Move Mountains]

[Divine Power: Strengthen]

[Divine Power: Elemental Body]

[Divine Power: World]

[Divine Power: Tear Heaven]

[Divine Power: Fierce Sun Opening Heaven]

[Divine Power: Lord Status]

[Divine Power: Past Body]

[Divine Power: Return to Origin]

[Divine Power: Feathering Ascension]

[Divine Power: Phantom True Body]

...

A sequence of phantasmal text flashes below the sight, reflecting the record of divine powers Lin Yuan has mastered as noted by the Myriad Realms Gate.

The Divine Power 'Past Body' is a Physical Body Divine Ability awakened by Lin Yuan in the Great Wilderness Origin World, originating from the Three-Life Immortal Emperor. With this divine power, Lin Yuan perfected the Three-Life Arcana, paving the road to becoming a lord.

Although 'Past Body' doesn't directly bolster Lin Yuan's combat power, it saves an immeasurable amount of time and effort. Without such a divine power, merely consolidating individual timelines would take Lin Yuan tens of thousands to millions of years.

How could he possibly cross into the Third Realm and become a lord within a mere sixty thousand years?
